_comment: Deep history (PF-5j; APIs.md, Deep history; src/history-config.ts). History before the 3-year layer (boundary = knowledge/index/backfill.json targetStart) goes into immutable `history-YYYY` Release assets only: per source month a raw asset, per month an events edition built offline by the backfill's Resolver. The data branch gains only knowledge/index/history.json. `enabled` is the switch of the hourly history.yml walk. Era `pilot` is the year before the boundary, every magnitude: ComCat alone in edition 1 (2026-10-01), then every FDSN source of the 3-year layer but ISC (paused, owner P-1) for edition 2 (round 15), in registry priority order. Era `A` (owner-approved next step, round 15) continues the same 17 sources, every magnitude, from 2022-07-01 back to 2000-01-01, month by month (the walk goes newest first, so it starts once the pilot's edition 2 is fetched). Later eras (proposal in the platform plan, PF-5j) wait for the owner's depth targets: M>=4.5 back to 1973 (B), M>=6 back to 1900 (C).
